body.data:
SELECT
    R.REQUEST_ID,
    R.CONTRACT_SERIAL,
    R.CONTRACT_PDF_REF,
    R.BANK_SHEET_REF,
    R.RECEIVED_AT,
    R.REQUEST_DATE,
    R.PREVIOUS_REQUEST_DATE,
    R.STATUS,
    R.CURRENT_STAGE,
    R.MAKER_ID,
    R.MAKER_ACTION,
    R.MAKER_AT,
    R.FRAUD_ID,
    R.FRAUD_ACTION,
    R.FRAUD_AT,
    R.CHECKER_ID,
    R.CHECKER_ACTION,
    R.CHECKER_AT,
    R.REJECT_REASON_CODE,
    R.REJECT_REASON_DESC,
    R.BANK_PUSHBACK_NOTE,
    R.CREATED_AT,
    R.UPDATED_AT,
    R.CREATED_BY,
    R.UPDATED_BY
FROM TALY_BO_REP.MMS_ONBOARDING_REQUEST R
WHERE R.REQUEST_ID = HEXTORAW('{{ appsmith.URL.queryParams.REQUEST_ID || "59F2A096DB137D26E063C642320AB95B" }}')
  AND R.IS_DELETED = 0
